articles.title: What sort of maths are LLMs good at?
articles.author: ColinWright

zh.thesis: LLM强于构造反例，因擅长海量尝试而非深刻概念性论证。
points: OpenAI解决十大难题多为反例/构造而非定理证明
索菲群、多色Ramsey、Jacobian猜想等均为反例型
作者推测LLM风格是「大量尝试碰运气」，人类强在出奇概念论证

en.thesis: LLMs excel at constructing counterexamples because they favor massive trial-and-error over deep conceptual arguments.
points: OpenAI's ten solved problems lean toward counterexamples and constructions rather than theorem proofs
Sophie groups, multicolor Ramsey, and the Jacobian conjecture are all counterexample-type results
Author bets LLM style is 'large-scale luck-seeking' while humans shine at surprising conceptual proofs

articles.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
articles.author: ropbear

zh.thesis: Tailscale历时半年定位16年历史的SQLite WAL-Reset竞态，并贡献修复。
points: 6个月19起损坏，均因手动+激进checkpoint触发
SQLite官方修复为3.51.3版，撤回含回归的3.52.0
部署tmstmpvfs shim排查，确认后4个月零事故

en.thesis: Tailscale spent six months tracing data corruption to a 16-year-old SQLite WAL-Reset race and contributed the fix.
points: 19 corruptions in 6 months, each triggered by manual plus aggressive checkpoints
SQLite's official fix landed in 3.51.3, rolling back the regression-laden 3.52.0
A tmstmpvfs shim confirmed the cause; four months post-fix, zero incidents

zh.thesis: AI代理由十种可复用架构模式组成，应按任务难易分层选模型。
points: 5步链每步95%成功率，整体仅约77%
法官模型若弱于作者，审阅即成为橡皮图章
拆分独立任务可省5-10倍token成本，并可逐任务降级换便宜模型

en.thesis: AI agents are built from ten reusable architectural patterns, and model choice should be tiered by task difficulty.
points: A 5-step chain with 95% per-step success yields only about 77% overall
A judge model weaker than the author makes review a rubber stamp
Splitting independent tasks cuts 5-10x token cost and allows per-task downgrades to cheaper models

articles.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering
articles.author: florianherrengt

zh.thesis: AI让实现变廉价，但弱工程文化团队会更快崩溃，好工程师更值钱。
points: 代码量与生成速度远超审查能力，坏决策5倍速叠加
修复AI烂决策成本远高于生成，迁移与孤儿外键难回退
作者断言薪资两极分化：可用AI的强者增值，弱者无法雇佣

en.thesis: AI makes implementation cheap, but teams with weak engineering culture fail faster while good engineers become more valuable.
points: Code volume and generation speed far outpace review capacity, compounding bad decisions 5x
Fixing AI's bad decisions costs far more than generating them; migrations and orphaned foreign keys are hard to revert
Author predicts wage polarization: AI-capable engineers get more valuable while weaker ones become unhireable

articles.title: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
articles.author: apwheele

zh.thesis: 历史ALPR数据搜索应由立法强制令拦截，删除数据并不能防滥用。
points: Norfolk案后弗吉尼亚州统一保留21天，各州多在30天左右
删除数据不防滥用：滥用者每20天搜索一次即可
作者建议保留短时实况搜索，历史搜索需司法令 + 第三方审计

en.thesis: Historical ALPR data searches should be gated by a legislative warrant; deleting data doesn't stop abuse.
points: Virginia standardized 21-day retention after the Norfolk case; most states keep around 30 days
Deletion doesn't deter abuse: a bad actor just searches every 20 days
Author suggests keeping short-lived live searches legal but requiring a judicial warrant plus third-party audit for historical ones

articles.title: Most people pay $20 for Claude Code, but OpenCode Go is $10 and I can barely spend a dollar of it
articles.author: Adam Conway

zh.thesis: OpenCode Go以10美元月费提供接近免费的主力模型与旗舰备用模型。
points: DeepSeek V4 Flash一天重度使用实测仅花3美分
V4 Flash SWE-bench 79%，逼近Claude Sonnet 4.6的79.6%
Kimi K3为2.8T参数开源大模型，5小时窗口仅110次请求

en.thesis: OpenCode Go's $10 monthly plan offers a near-free primary model plus a flagship backup model.
points: A heavy day of DeepSeek V4 Flash usage cost just 3 cents
V4 Flash scores 79% on SWE-bench, close to Claude Sonnet 4.6's 79.6%
Kimi K3 is a 2.8T-parameter open model; the 5-hour window allows only 110 requests

zh.thesis: Grok 4.6聚焦长时运行代理，评测追平GPT-5.6 Sol与Fable 5。
points: AA Intelligence Index 61分，与GPT-5.6 Sol并列、略低于Fable 5的62
定价每百万输入2美元、输出6美元，快变体价格翻倍
API定价：$2/百万输入tokens，$6/百万输出tokens

en.thesis: Grok 4.6 targets long-running agents and now matches GPT-5.6 Sol and Fable 5 in benchmarks.
points: Scored 61 on the AA Intelligence Index, tying GPT-5.6 Sol and just below Fable 5's 62
Priced at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens
The fast variant carries a doubled price

zh.thesis: Qwen3.8开源2.4T参数MoE模型，首款开源版Qwen-Max级能力。
points: 共2.4T参数，激活95B，512专家路由10个
原生上下文262144，可扩至1010000 tokens
SWE-bench Pro 67.7、GPQA Diamond 92.6，终端41%

en.thesis: Qwen3.8 is the first open-source model with Qwen-Max-level capability, a 2.4T-parameter MoE.
points: 2.4T total parameters, 95B active, with 512 experts routing to 10
Native 262,144-token context, expandable to 1.01M tokens
SWE-bench Pro 67.7, GPQA Diamond 92.6, terminal score 41%

articles.title: Google's AI found a Chrome bug hiding for 13 years, and it's only getting faster
articles.author: Rich Edmonds

zh.thesis: Google用专用AI代理全流程修Chrome漏洞，补丁量超此前23个里程碑总和。
points: Chrome 149、150两版共修复1072个安全漏洞
「life of a bug」流程：发现、分诊、生成补丁、测试全自动化
5月工具拦截20余漏洞入生产，仍由开发者审查最终补丁

en.thesis: Google's dedicated AI agents now fix Chrome bugs end-to-end, shipping more patches than all prior 23 milestones combined.
points: Chrome 149 and 150 together fixed 1,072 security vulnerabilities
The 'life of a bug' pipeline automates discovery, triage, patch generation, and testing
In May the tool kept 20+ bugs out of production; developers still review every final patch

articles.title: I can't believe how good this AI coding model is, and it isn't from OpenAI or Anthropic
articles.author: Parth Shah

zh.thesis: Grok 4.5在Cursor中token极省，40k构建整个网站，效率胜过顶尖模型。
points: 完整网站仅耗约40k tokens，速度快且不铺张
小改动直接改相关文件，不重复扫描整个代码库
复杂任务仍切换Fable 5或Claude Code，非全场景默认

en.thesis: Grok 4.5 in Cursor is remarkably token-efficient, building an entire site on 40k tokens and beating top models.
points: Built a complete website on roughly 40k tokens, fast and unextravagant
Small edits touch only relevant files without rescanning the whole codebase
Complex tasks still fall back to Fable 5 or Claude Code rather than defaulting everywhere
